Very average.
Dec 2022 • Solo
I was staying in District 1 where I guess most tourists stay. I took a taxi here. They are located in District 2 so you will need to do the same if in a similar situation. Located off a long quiet side road and not easy to find otherwise. Area is nice. Very chic and hip and less chaotic. Nice menu of brunch classics. Not too busy early Monday afternoon. I sat by the window on a high seat table. I ordered the Granola Bowl. On the menu it said house-baked granola, homemade Greek yogurt, apple, banana, orange, kiwi, raspberry, dried strawberry, chia seeds + make it vegan (berry smoothie). I opted for vegan with a bottle of still water. I agree somewhat with the previous reviewer. Small portion and very unsatisfying. Light but not very tasty. Wasn't worth the price or coming all that way. Staff are friendly and pleasant. They even called a taxi for me after I had eaten. If your in the area but not worthy of a special trip.

Very bad price-performance-ratio
Dec 2022 • Couples
Pretty restaurant, but very bad price-performance-ratio. I had the vegan granola (berry smoothie instead of the greek yogurt). The size of the portion was a bad joke. I left hungry and drove to the charm bakery in the city center. Prize: 160K (only the granola). My girlfriend had the avocado tartine. The taste and size was okay. Total we paid 442.800 Dong for 2 meal and 1 cup matcha latte. If I want, I get for that in HCM City 3 meal in total with better taste. The restaurant demands at the end 8% VAT - for what? The only thing we can recommend is the security man in front of the restaurant. He was very kind and friendly.

My first time going there
Oct 2022
Today I went to meet a friend at Cafe Marcel. Stepping from a busy street I was instantly greeted by friendly staff and a relaxing environment. As it was my first time going there, the server politely explained both the food and drink menu and allowed me time to make my choices. I was promptly given my drink and without being rushed given a generous plate of food. The house made sausages had the perfect level of spice and my eggs were perfect for dipping the crunchy sourdough toast. All in all I can not recommend this place enough. Great addition to Saigon if you’re looking for a meeting point or delicious, fresh breakfast!
